verdict.rationale: The portal claims users can quickly obtain 'todos os esclarecimentos' (all clarifications) on tax and customs obligations. This points to first-party guidance content for taxpayers, but nothing shows whether it takes the form of plain-language, step-by-step explainers rather than statute references or a helpdesk channel. Missing for 10: evidence of step-by-step task guides, plain-language explainers aimed at founders or non-lawyers, examples of actual guidance pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of usability.
